verdict.rationale: First-party docs say packages deliver a wide range of enhancements through the Package Manager, and the UPM registry resolves official packages such as the AI Assistant and Sentis. Community reports from VideoLAN confirm a Unity Store that distributes third-party plugins, though they also describe inconsistent store-policy treatment. Missing for 10: first-party Asset Store documentation, evidence of the store's size or breadth, evidence of ready-made 3D models/art assets, and independent hands-on corroboration of ecosystem quality.
